nodes.label: ADR-005 — Canvas com React Flow; execução 100% no backend
Decision: React Flow editor, graph serialized as JSON in Postgres; frontend only edits, execution exclusively in flow-runtime
nodes.rationale: React Flow has the largest training representation among node editors (custom nodes, typed handles, connection validation generated reliably). Server-side execution is deterministic and independent of any open browser; cost: a backend graph interpreter (topological order, signal typing) is required.
